developer.match: Match each game to the studio that made it.
developer.odd: Three of these games were made by {value}. Which one wasn't?
developer.reverse: Which of these games did {value} make?

rows.label: Valheim
rows.hook: has players survive in a Norse-inspired afterlife, building longhouses and slaying giant bosses with friends

rows.label: Black Myth: Wukong
rows.description: 2024 video game developed by Game Science
rows.hook: is an action RPG based on the classic Chinese tale of the Journey to the West, with a Monkey King hero

rows.label: Among Us
rows.hook: became a pandemic-era phenomenon as crewmates hunt for a hidden impostor on a spaceship

rows.label: Hollow Knight
rows.hook: sends a tiny bug warrior through a ruined underground insect kingdom in a hand-drawn metroidvania

rows.label: It Takes Two
rows.description: 2021 action-adventure video game developed by Hazelight Studios
rows.hook: forces two feuding parents, turned into dolls, to cooperate in a co-op-only adventure to fix their marriage

rows.label: Palworld
rows.description: 2026 video game developed by Pocket Pair
rows.hook: was nicknamed monster-collecting with guns, as captured creatures work on a farm

rows.label: Pokémon Legends: Z-A
rows.description: 2025 video game developed by Game Freak
rows.hook: sets its creature-catching action in a redeveloped French-inspired metropolis, with real-time battles

rows.label: Split Fiction
rows.description: 2025 video game developed by Hazelight Studios
rows.hook: is a co-op adventure where two writers are trapped in simulations of sci-fi and fantasy worlds

rows.label: Hollow Knight: Silksong
rows.description: 2025 Metroidvania action-adventure video game developed by Team Cherry
rows.hook: follows the long-awaited sequel starring a needle-wielding hunter named Hornet on a pilgrimage

rows.label: Kirby and the Forgotten Land
rows.hook: lets a pink puffball explore a ruined modern world and swallow whole cars with a Mouthful Mode

rows.label: Super Mario Odyssey
rows.hook: lets a plumber throw his sentient hat to capture enemies while traveling the globe to stop a wedding

rows.label: Balatro
rows.hook: is a hit roguelike deckbuilder built around poker hands and wild joker cards

rows.label: Monster Hunter Wilds
rows.hook: sends players across a vast desert land to take down enormous beasts with a wide range of weapons

rows.label: Street Fighter 6
rows.hook: is a fighting game with a World Tour story mode and Drive Gauge, featuring Ryu, Chun-Li and Luke

rows.label: Garry's Mod
rows.hook: began as a sandbox with physics tools and became famous for player-made chaos, props and roleplay servers

rows.label: Euro Truck Simulator 2
rows.description: 2012 vehicle simulation video game made by SCS Software
rows.hook: is a calm, cult-favorite game about hauling cargo across European roads in a big rig

rows.label: Pokémon Emerald
rows.hook: returns to the Hoenn region in an expanded third-generation remake-like adventure with a Battle Frontier

rows.label: Pokémon Legends: Arceus
rows.hook: drops players into the ancient Hisui region, a prequel to Sinnoh, where they build the very first dex

rows.label: Sea of Thieves
rows.hook: lets crews sail a pirate ship together, hunt for treasure and fight off skeleton ships and a giant kraken

rows.label: Sonic Frontiers
rows.description: 2022 platform video game developed by Sonic Team
rows.hook: takes the blue speedster into an open-world style adventure across mysterious islands with a Cyber Space

rows.label: Dave the Diver
rows.hook: mixes deep-ocean fishing by day with running a sushi restaurant by night

rows.label: Monster Hunter: World
rows.hook: brought a hunting series to a wider audience with seamless ecosystems like the Ancient Forest

rows.label: Cities: Skylines
rows.hook: lets players zone, build roads and manage traffic and services for a growing metropolis

rows.label: Pokémon Platinum
rows.hook: is the third entry in the Sinnoh generation, known for the Distortion World and a legendary ghost-dragon

rows.label: Super Mario Party Jamboree
rows.hook: is a board-style game with over a hundred minigames and a mode starring a flower named Wiggler

rows.label: Civilization VI
rows.hook: is a turn-based strategy game where districts sprawl across the map as you steer an empire through the ages

rows.label: Super Smash Bros. Brawl
rows.description: 2008 crossover fighting video game by Nintendo
rows.hook: is a crossover brawler with a story mode called The Subspace Emissary and a roster that added Snake and Sonic

rows.label: Yo-kai Watch 2
rows.hook: lets players befriend spooky spirits to fight with, and came out in two paired versions

rows.label: Monster Hunter Rise
rows.description: 2021 action/RPG video game developed by Capcom
rows.hook: lets hunters ride a dog-like companion and use wirebug moves against giant beasts
